sentences.text: This case report describes two siblings with ataxia, cognitive decline, and progressive demyelination who inherited a specific ACOX1 gene variant from their asymptomatic mother while maintaining normal levels of very long chain fatty acids.
Brain magnetic resonance imaging revealed that these individuals experienced progressive loss of myelin and underdevelopment of the corpus callosum.
Furthermore, a specialized MRI technique called NODDI indicated that the siblings had a lower intraneurite fraction and a smaller orientation dispersion index compared to their parents.
The authors suggest that diffusion MRI microstructure modeling could be a useful tool for diagnosing and monitoring hypomyelinating conditions.
